span.p: No root cause. Named gaps only.

span.p: Triage. AGENT. Plans the pack. Does not diagnose.

span.p: Hypotheses. AGENT. Names four classes. Does not pick one.

span.p: Tool calls. AGENT. Read-only. At most 10.
